localidad: Reserva Guaquira, Vereda Pueblo Nuevo, Ubaque, Cundinamarca
comentarios: Very long sequence of one adult male singing on forest edge , it was not clear for me the context of the song but I presumed could be territorial because I heard another male (previous recordings) doing similar vocalizations in front of one female. I want to dedicate this recording to the memory of the colombian biologist Gustavo Kattan who unfortunately passed away some weks ago. He was a very influential conservation biologist and ornithologist in Colombia and the neotropics as well, and made long term studies with birds mainly in the central andes in Otum Quimbaya sanctuary and western andes near Cali. One of his favorite and most studies  groups were precisely the cracids, particularly the Cauca guan.This my personal way to make a tribute to his legacy in research, conservation and education. Andres Angulo.
